name: Colette
source:
A girl who works as a weaver on the island. She has lost her parents at a young age, and has lived alone with her brother Lauro since. She is good at household chores, but hopeless at cooking. 

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/enigma/]Fruitbat Factory[/url]]
